supplements: auxsays/scripts/audit/live_citation_withdrawal.json (AUX-088), live_citation_withdrawal_v2.json (AUX-090), live_citation_withdrawal_v3.json (AUX-098), live_citation_withdrawal_v4.json (AUX-108), live_citation_withdrawal_v5.json (AUX-111), live_citation_withdrawal_v6.json (AUX-114) and live_citation_withdrawal_v7.json (AUX-118), which stay unchanged
purpose: Pinned withdrawal of one stored OBS Studio 32.1.1 report that was posted the day before OBS Studio 32.1.1 was released. The OBS acceptance gate refuses such a report (collect_obs_reports.release_date_gate returns before_release_date); this row was accepted before the gate read the post date. The row is kept; only counted and exclusion_reason change.

edit.exclusion_reason: before_release_date (derived; the OBS collector's own rejection string)
edit.evidence_valid_for_current_patch: not present on OBS rows; a block carrying it refuses

derivation.gate: collect_obs_reports.release_date_gate(issue, release_date): before_release_date when the report's own UTC creation day is earlier than the record's release day
derivation.post_time_source: auxsays/scripts/audit/obs_report_dates.json (AUX-090): source.created_at, read once from the GitHub REST API
derivation.recomputed: on every run, by the tool, by calling the gate; the run refuses unless the gate returns before_release_date and the stored source_date is the pinned post day

basis: No label decides this withdrawal. The report's own creation time, pinned from its source, is 2026-04-01T12:05:03Z; OBS Studio 32.1.1 was released 2026-04-02T19:54:40Z. A report posted before a release cannot report a problem with that release, and the OBS acceptance gate refuses one. The stored source_date (2026-04-01) is the pinned post day.
note: The entry must match exactly one stored block whose sha256 equals block_sha256_before (to withdraw) or block_sha256_after (already withdrawn). No retain entries: it is not a duplicate. The must-stay rows are the first two counted 32.1.1 reports posted after the release, which the same gate accepts.

entries.basis: Posted 2026-04-01 (UTC), the day before OBS Studio 32.1.1 was released on 2026-04-02; the OBS acceptance gate returns before_release_date for it.

must_stay_counted.control_role: the earliest counted 32.1.1 report posted after the release (2026-04-03T05:22Z UTC); the gate accepts it
the earliest counted 32.1.1 GitHub issue posted after the release (2026-04-03T07:38:07Z); the gate accepts it

out_of_scope.why: Not a pre-release report (posted 2026-06-05, after the 2026-04-21 release). It needs its own adjudicated withdrawal; it is not touched here.
